dogecoin.text: @WesErwin3 Dogecoin was created as a joke almost a decade ago.  Now it's worth a fortune.  That is how you can tell that pure speculation is driving its value higher.  There is no underlying value, unlike with a business or real estate. It's a house of cards, not backed by any government.

My waitress, Annie, told me stocks are a gamble; too risky. But she buys Dogecoin - now that's gambling. If in 1990 you bought and held $10,000 worth of the NASDAQ 100 (100 of the largest firms on the NASDAQ exchange), you would have $320,000 today. Buy and hold is not gambling. https://t.co/UNPfqwdTb1
